CREATE TABLE platform_release_requests (
    request_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
    space_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES platform_spaces,
    user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES platform_users,
    member_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES platform_members,
    request_key TEXT NOT NULL,
    fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL,
    form_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    version_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    build_input TEXT NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE (space_id, user_id, request_key),
    FOREIGN KEY (form_id, version_id) REFERENCES platform_versions(form_id, version_id)
  ) STRICT;
  CREATE TABLE platform_releases (
    release_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
    request_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES platform_release_requests,
    form_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    version_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    target TEXT NOT NULL,
    prepared_text TEXT NOT NULL,
    digest TEXT NOT NULL,
    diagnostics TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (form_id, version_id) REFERENCES platform_versions(form_id, version_id)
  ) STRICT;
  CREATE INDEX platform_releases_by_form ON platform_releases (form_id);
  CREATE TABLE platform_release_audit (
    release_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL REFERENCES platform_releases,
    actor_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES platform_users,
    recorded_at TEXT NOT NULL
  ) STRICT;

ALTER TABLE platform_release_requests ADD COLUMN release_name TEXT;
   ALTER TABLE platform_releases ADD COLUMN release_name TEXT;
ALTER TABLE platform_versions ADD COLUMN version_name TEXT;

CREATE TABLE platform_join_requests (
    sequence INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    request_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES platform_users,
    space_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES platform_spaces,
    explanation TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('pending','approved','rejected','withdrawn')),
    revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    decided_at TEXT,
    decided_by TEXT REFERENCES platform_users,
    reason TEXT,
    roles TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'
  ) STRICT;
  CREATE UNIQUE INDEX platform_join_pending ON platform_join_requests(user_id,space_id) WHERE status='pending';
  CREATE INDEX platform_join_by_space ON platform_join_requests(space_id,status,sequence);
  CREATE INDEX platform_join_by_user ON platform_join_requests(user_id,space_id,sequence);
